catalog_quote: A.2 Stress Although stress contrasts are infrequent in Tuparı́, there are some minimal pairs that show that this language can employ stress to distinguish between otherwise homophonous lexical items. For instance, the verbal root for ‘speak’, ma’ẽ [mã."Pẽ], is stressed on the last syllable, whereas that for ‘carry’, ma’ẽ ["mã.Pẽ], has initial stress. There is also at least one near-minimal pair in the domain of reduplicated nouns: korakora [ko."Ra.ko."Ra] ‘chicken’ is stressed on syllables two and four, whereas hurahura ["h0.Ra."h0.Ra] ‘tucunaré’ is stressed on syllables one and three. ... Functional morphology such as auxiliaries are unstressed: ... In example (a) primary stress falls on the lexical verbal root ’et ‘sleep’; the subsequent habitual auxiliary, ’apteka [Pap^.te.ka], is deaccented. In example (b) stress stills fall on ’et ‘sleep’, with both of the subsequent auxiliaries de…

tone_statements.quote: Of the branches in Rondônia, Karitiana (ISO:ktn) the remaining language of the Arikém branch, is said to have non-contrastive pitch accent (Storto 1999, Storto & Demolin 2005). The one remaining language of the Ramarama branch, Karo (ISO:arr), is analyzed as having pitch accent (Gabas 1999). The Tupari branch and the Puruborá branch have not been reported as tonal.

tone_statements.summary: No lexical tone reported for the Tupari branch (branch-level survey statement); stress/length only per descriptions.

audit.recode_to: Keep classification lexical (word domain). Consider annotating a positional tendency: Couto & Isidoro 2018:64 say phonological stress falls 'principalmente na última sílaba' with penult/antepenult exceptions, whereas the record currently says 'No default or predictable stress position is stated'. Also add a caution that earlier work (Alves 1991 apud Seki 2002; Rodrigues & Caspar 1957/2017 apud Isidoro 2020:306) treated stress as non-distinctive/undecided and that Singerman calls the system under-researched.
audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check: both the deciding quote (App. A.2, pp. 377-378) and the the domain quotation/orthography quote (section 1.6, p. 18) are verbatim in the extracted text we hold of Singerman 2018; locators correct. (2) Deciding source is a 2018 fieldwork-based PhD dissertation of reference-grammar scope (443 pp), the top item in Glottolog's list; but its stress treatment is two pages and explicitly preliminary. (3) Searched for better stress sources: downloaded Isidoro 2020 (UnB PhD, open) — its phonology appendix p. 306 only restates Rodrigues & Caspar's undecided classification and reports (p. 60, via Seki 2002) that Alves 1991 considered stress non-distinctive; downloaded Couto & Isidoro 2018 (RBLA, open, instrumental) — p. 64 affirms stress is phonological, mostly final, with penult/antepenult cases, which supports 'lexical' and adds a majority-final tendency our record lacks. sources.citation: Couto, Fábio Pereira & Edineia Aparecida Isidoro. 2018. Evidências acústicas da laringalização vocálica na língua Tuparí. Revista Brasileira de Linguística Antropológica 10(1): 59-74. doi:10.26512/rbla.v10i1.19054
sources.quote: 'No que diz respeito ao acento em Tuparí, pode-se afirmar que ele é fonológico sendo que ele ocorre principalmente na última sílaba /iˈtop/ olhe e /heʔˈem/ isto ..., mas podendo ocorrer na penúltima /ˈkwĩnĩ/ forquilha e ainda na antepenúltima /aˈpekiap/ amolador.' (authors' own preliminary phonemic analysis 'apoiados na descrição feita por Alves (2004)')

sources.citation: Isidoro, Edineia Aparecida. 2020. Morfossintaxe da língua Tuparí (família Tuparí, tronco Tupí): flexão relacional e casual e o sistema de dêiticos demonstrativos. Tese de doutorado, Universidade de Brasília. 360 pp.
sources.quote: p. 306: 'os dados indicam diferenças de duração e intensidade ... entre sílabas acentuadas e não acentuadas. Estes fenômenos prosódicos não foram anotados continuamente ... Não se pode decidir se a duração e a intensidade possuem relevância fonológica. ... [ˈaˈpɛ] e [ˈa.ˈpɛ] caminho; [ˈɛtɛra] e [ɛtˈɛ.ra] vá! ... Como solução provisória, duração e intensidade não foram consideradas como fonêmicas' (restating Rodrigues & Caspar 2017[1957]). p. 60 (Seki 2002 quoted): 'Persistem ainda dúvidas ... quanto ao status da duração vocálica e do acento, considerados como não distintivos por Alves'.
